hypothesis.statement: [causal_all_bin] Summarise each user's and item's history as a long_view rate using a time-ordered prefix so no row sees its own label
hypothesis.mechanism: The ID model has no behavioural summary; an explicit historical rate should add personalisation it cannot represent

audit.detail: validation jumped +0.1182 in one step; require backtest-fold confirmation before trusting

hypothesis.statement: [causal_all_lmr] Summarise each user's and item's history as a long_view rate using a time-ordered prefix so no row sees its own label, optimised with LambdaRank over per-day lists
hypothesis.mechanism: The ID model has no behavioural summary; an explicit historical rate should add personalisation it cannot represent; the metric is a ranking metric, so a ranking objective should align the loss with what is scored

hypothesis.statement: [frozen_all_bin] Same aggregates, but frozen at the start of each evaluation window
hypothesis.mechanism: Evaluation ranks a user's list as a set, so list-mate labels are not available at scoring time and must not enter the features
hypothesis.predicted_effect: validation falls toward test; the val-test gap collapses
